title: No Witness
summary: Start: enter No Witness. The log opens the job and the helm marks the home buoy. Do: enter the interceptor sight, 520 meters of the home buoy. An interceptor closes, a kite keeps range, and a raider takes whatever is flying. Open wreck rights. Nobody writes it down. Finish: after the sight is sprung, come inside Classroom's shell. Red Keel heat rises. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close. The shell alone does not file it.
